key.name: whitelist
key.description: Exact comm names (/proc/PID/comm) of processes the reaper must never terminate: the GNOME session itself and dropdown/terminal processes.

key.name: grace-period-ms
key.description: How long to wait between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when force-closing a window's process.

key.name: show-notifications
key.summary: Show a notification on every kill
key.description: When enabled, WaylandReaper sends a desktop notification each time it terminates a process or skips a whitelisted one. Off by default.

key.name: kill-focused-window
key.description: Accelerator for terminating the focused window's process. Empty = disabled.

key.name: kill-focused-window-alt
key.description: Second accelerator, same action. Empty string list = disabled.
